cards.name: Tropical Beach

availability.basis: Official Pokémon Card announcement gives the release date of High Class Pack TAG TEAM GX Tag All Stars; the official card page identifies Trevenant & Dusknoir-GX as SM12a 179/173 (and 053/173).

matching_text: Night Watch 150 with two random cards from the opponent's hand revealed and shuffled into their deck.
